blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.
blocks.zh: 将视觉语言模型(VLMs)与参数效率微调(PEFT)相结合,为在计算病理学中进行几发全滑图像(WSI)分类提供了一个很有希望的方法. 本研究评价了从非人类灵长类肝脏组织学中预测乙醇饮用状态的方法. 在猴子酒精组织研究资源(MATRR)的一个子集上,对照非PEFT配置来评价适配器. 所有经过评价的PEFT配置都实现了高于非PEFT基线的平均值平衡准确度. 例如,在四拍设定中,仅基于注意力的多实例学习(ABMIL)就实现了43.5%的均衡精度,而在添加了适配器后则达到了78.1%。 定性关注分析显示,文字路径适应产生局部关注热图,而视觉路径适应则产生更分散的热图. 一位病理学家的审查发现,在各种适应中,类似的组织特征。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) is challenging to investigate in human populations due to confounding genetic and lifestyle factors [ 1 ] . Animal models provide controlled experimental settings for studying alcohol-induced liver pathology and disease progression [ 2 ] . In particular, nonhuman primates exhibit histological features that resemble human liver disease, making them valuable for translational research [ 3 ] . Previous studies have demonstrated the feasibility of predicting ethanol drinking categories from nonhuman primate liver histology using deep learning [ 4 ] . However, the application of vision-language models (VLMs) to this setting remains underexplored, particularly when labeled data are limited.
blocks.zh: 与酒精有关的肝脏疾病(ALD)由于基因和生活方式因素混淆而难以在人类中进行调查。 动物模型为研究由酒精引起的肝脏病理学和疾病发展提供了有控制的实验环境[2]. 特别是,非人类灵长类动物表现出了与人类肝病相似的神学特征,使它们对翻译研究很有价值[3]. 以往的研究表明,通过深入学习,从非人类灵长类肝脏组织学中预测乙醇饮用类别的可行性[4]. 然而,在这种情况下,视觉语言模型(VLMs)的应用仍然没有得到充分利用,特别是在贴有标签的数据有限的情况下。

blocks.en: In computational pathology, a typical data point is a gigapixel-resolution whole slide image (WSI), which presents challenges for learning from slide-level labels when disease-related features may be localized to small regions across the slide [ 5 ] . To address the limitations of relying on exhaustive pixel-level manual annotations, multiple instance learning (MIL) is commonly used. MIL treats each slide as a bag of patches and learns slide-level predictions without patch annotations. Attention-based MIL (ABMIL) [ 6 ] introduces a trainable gated attention mechanism to weight patches based on their importance and form a slide-level representation. However, MIL architectures can add tens of thousands of trainable parameters, which may increase the risk of overfitting when labeled data are limited. Since obtaining large-scale annotated datasets for specific clinical tasks can be unfeasible, there is a need for models that generalize under few-shot, weakly supervised constraints [ 7 ] . These challenges motivated few-shot weakly supervised WSI classification (FSWC) [ 8 ] . In this setting, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) technique [ 9 ] is leveraged to adapt VLMs using a minimal number of trainable parameters, while keeping the large-parameter-space encoder backbones frozen.
blocks.zh: 在计算病理学中,一个典型的数据点是一个千兆像素分辨率整体的幻灯片图像(WSI),当与疾病有关的特性可能局部化到整个幻灯片的小区域时,它为从幻灯片级别标签中学习带来挑战 [5]. 为了解决依赖详尽的像素级手动说明的局限性,常用多例学习(MIL). MIL将每张幻灯片当作一包补丁,并学习没有补丁说明的幻灯片水平预测. 基于注意的MIL(ABMIL)[6]根据重量补丁的重要性,引入了可被训练入门的注意机制,并形成滑行级代表. 然而,MIL架构可以添加数以万计的可被训练参数,这可能会增加被标记数据有限时过于适应的风险. 由于获得针对特定临床任务的大规模注解数据集可能不可行,因此需要在几发,受弱监督的制约下通用模型[7]. 这些挑战促使对世界安全倡议分类(FSWC)监督不力的几发子弹[8]。 在这个设置中,利用一个参数效率高的微调(PEFT)技术[9]来用最小数量的可训练参数来调整VLM,同时使大参数-空间编码器主干线被冻结.

blocks.en: VLMs such as CONtrastive learning from Captions for Histopathology (CONCH) [ 10 ] are pretrained through pretraining on diverse histological image-text pairs to learn transferable visual representations for downstream pathology tasks. Several FSWC approaches incorporate language information to improve slide-level learning. Two-level Prompt Learning (TOP) [ 8 ] uses pathology language priors to guide patch aggregation and prompt learning, while FOCUS [ 11 ] filters redundant patch features and uses language guidance to prioritize diagnostically relevant regions. MIL-Adapter [ 12 ] combines textual ensemble learning with slide aggregation and vision-language adapters. This study builds upon the MIL-Adapter, and adapts its framework to the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR) dataset [ 13 ] to investigate few-shot, weakly supervised classification of ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver WSIs, establishing a proof of concept for integration of PEFT and VLM in translational ALD research.
blocks.zh: 诸如Contrastive从Captions for Histopathology(CONCH)[10]等VLM,通过对各种神学图像-文字对子的预训,以学习下游病理学任务的可转移视觉表现. 一些FSWC方法纳入了语言信息来改进幻灯片级学习. 两级即时学习(TOP)[8]使用病理学语言前作来指导补丁汇总和即时学习,而FOCUS[11]过滤冗余的补丁特性并使用语言指导来优先考虑诊断相关区域. MIL-Adapter [12] 将文字综艺学习与幻灯片聚合和视觉语言适配器相结合. 本研究以MIL-Adapter为基础,并调整其框架以适应"猴子酒精组织研究资源"(MATRR)数据集[13],以调查从非人类灵长类肝脏活性病毒对乙醇饮用状况的几发而监督不力的分类,建立将PEFT和VLM纳入翻译ALD研究的概念证明.

blocks.en: II Method
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 provides an overview of the workflow. The framework employs the frozen image and text encoders of CONCH [ 10 ] , pre-trained on 1.17 million histopathology image–text pairs. Text prompts are constructed that are relevant to liver pathology. Let P P be a set of prefix strings and M c M_{c} be a set of morphological descriptors associated with class c ∈ { 0 , 1 } c\in\{0,1\} . The prefixes are “An H&E stained liver slide showing” and “Histopathological examination of a liver slide displaying”. For the Non-Drinking (Control) class, M 0 M_{0} includes “orderly trabecular architecture”, “clear sinusoids”, “intact portal tracts”, “normal central veins”, and “unremarkable parenchyma”. For the Drinking class, M 1 M_{1} includes “macrovesicular steatosis”, “hepatocyte ballooning”, “Mallory-Denk bodies”, “neutrophilic infiltrate”, and “pericellular fibrosis”. The Cartesian product of P P and M c M_{c} generates K = 10 K=10 textual descriptions for each class. The frozen text encoder produces L 2 L_{2} -normalized features 𝐓 c , k ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{T}_{c,k}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} for prompt k k , where d = 512 d=512 . Mean pooling over the K K features forms the class text vector 𝐭 c ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{t}_{c}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} .

blocks.en: III Results
blocks.zh: 三. 结果

blocks.en:
The MATRR subset (cohorts 6a, 6b, 7a, 7b) consists of 37 WSIs from distinct rhesus macaques, comprising 13 Non-Drinking (Control) subjects and 24 Drinking subjects. Training and validation each contain two or four subjects per class; the remaining subjects are held out for testing. Each configuration is evaluated over 30 runs (10 iterations across three seeds). Models use AdamW with a base learning rate of 0.001.
Training runs for a maximum of 250 epochs with an early stopping patience of 50 epochs. The checkpoint with the lowest validation loss is selected. Table I reports classification performance as the balanced accuracy (BACC), the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and the F1 score.
blocks.zh:
MATR子集(cohorts 6a, 6b, 7a, 7b)由37个来自特异性恒河猴的WSI组成,由13个非饮用(控制)科目和24个饮用科目组成. 培训与鉴定每班各有两到四个科目;其余科目留作试验. 对每个组合的评价超过30次(3个种子重复了10次)。 模型使用亚当W,基础学习率为0.001.
训练时间最长为250个纪元,早期停止耐心50个纪元. 选择验证损失最低的检查站。 页:1 我报告将性能分类为平衡精度(BACC),接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUC)和F1分.

blocks.en: All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean BACC and AUC than both baselines at both shot settings. Relative to ABMIL, the D = 8 D=8 adapter increases mean BACC from 43.5% to 78.1% at four shots, while mean AUC increases from 33.4% to 83.6%. The visual pathway adapters achieve higher mean performance than TaskRes. The larger standard deviations suggest greater sensitivity to the sampled subjects, consistent with the variability commonly observed in few-shot learning due to limited training examples [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 所有经过评估的PEFT配置都实现了高于两个相机设置的基线的BACC和AUC的平均值. 相对于ABMIL,D=8 D=8的适配器在四发时平均从43.5%增加到78.1%,而AUC则从33.4%增加到83.6%. 视觉路径适配器实现比TaskRes更高的平均性能. 较大的标准偏差表明对被抽样的科目更加敏感,这与因培训实例有限而导致的几发学习通常观察到的可变性一致[15].

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Attention heatmaps and corresponding high-attention regions for a Drinking subject in the four-shot setting. TaskRes (left) shows localized attention, while visual adapters with D = 8 D=8 (middle) and D = 128 D=128 (right) attend more broadly.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 注意热图和相应的高注意区域,用于四发环境下的饮用。 TaskRes (左) 显示局部关注,而具有 D = 8 D = 8 (中)和 D = 128 D = 128 (右) 的可视适配器则更广泛地出席.

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows ABMIL attention weights mapped to patch coordinates and overlaid on the WSI of a Drinking subject in the four-shot setting. For this slide, TaskRes produces localized attention, whereas the visual adapters show broader attention distributions. Although all configurations learn patch attention through ABMIL, TaskRes adapts the class text features, whereas the visual adapters modify the aggregated slide representation. These differences in architecture and the placement of adaptation modules may contribute to the observed attention patterns.
blocks.zh: 图2显示ABMIL的注意分数,用于在四发设定中的饮用对象的WSI上补上坐标并覆盖。 对于此幻灯片,TaskRes会产生局部关注,而视觉适配器则显示更广泛的关注分布. 尽管所有配置都通过ABMIL学习补丁关注,但TaskRes调整了类文本功能,而可视适配器则修改了聚合幻灯片的表示. 结构上的这些差异和适应模块的设置可能会促进所观察到的注意模式。

blocks.en: A pathologist review of the attention heatmaps and callouts in Figure 2 found general concordance across the three models, with all three highlighting features consistent with rare single-cell necrosis, increased sinusoidal space, and/or minimal Ito cell hyperplasia. The ABMIL Adapter (D = 8) additionally identified a single focus of minimal microvesicular hepatocyte vacuolation or degeneration that was not flagged by the other models. Both ABMIL Adapters (D = 8 and D = 128) highlighted similar features, but the one with a lower bottleneck dimension was judged more discriminating overall. Although further validation is required, this suggests that the approach is a more promising candidate for further development.
blocks.zh: 在图2中对注意力热图和呼号进行的病理学家审查发现,这三种模型都具有总体一致性,所有三种突出特征都与罕见的单细胞坏死一致,增加了鼻膜空间和/或最小的Ito细胞高血压。 ABMIL适配器(D=8)还另外确定了其他型号未标出最小微管肝细胞分泌或分生的单焦. ABMIL适配器(D = 8和D = 128)都突出出类似的特征,但对于瓶颈分量较低的一个,总体上被判定更具有歧视性. 虽然还需要进一步验证,但这表明,这种办法是进一步发展的更有希望的选择。

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: In this work, a proof of concept is established for few-shot ethanol drinking-status classification from nonhuman primate liver histology. The investigation shows that MIL alone struggles to generalize directly from foundation model features, but integrating adaptation modules improves the classification performance in this setting. The illustrated heatmaps show localized attention for textual adapter and more diffuse attention for visual adapters, indicating that the two approaches produce different spatial patterns. Future work will evaluate the framework on larger datasets and test prompt sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,从非人类灵长类肝脏组织学中为几发乙醇饮用状态分类建立了概念证明. 调查显示,单是MIL就难以从基础模型特征中直接概括,但整合适应模块可以提高这种背景下的分类性能. 所显示的热图显示对文字适配器的局部注意和对视觉适配器的更分散的注意,表明两种方法产生不同的空间规律. 今后的工作将评价大型数据集框架并测试快速敏感性。
